about: Modelled as a generic product: base frame, posts, V-shaped finned coils with end panels and fan deck, three top fans (shroud, guard, hub, blades), two scroll compressors with domes and suction header under the V, lagged evaporator with flanged CHW nozzles, end electrical bay with doors, HMI and isolator. CHW connectors are not in the record (E only). Reference: query: chiller air cooled mechanical equipment hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=chiller+air+cooled+mechanical+equipment+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
